about: Ask the Map final (20 Nov 2026): questions written for the AI plan step, in English, Tamil and Tanglish, mostly ones the rules cannot read whole. Each `want` is what a correct plan must have: `show` is the op of the step the plan shows; `layers` must all be taken; `cats` / `family` must appear on the incidents' take; `meters`, `beyond`, `by`, `order`, `areas`, `area`, `kinds` checked when given; `understood: false` for a non-question. Scored by src/lib/map/mapai.live.ts.
